sources.title: utf8proc explicit-length UTF-8 processing
sources.confirmed: The header separates count-delimited input from NUL-terminated input and documents embedded NUL preservation, negative error returns, and caller-controlled storage through decomposition/reencoding.
sources.limits: Mapping may allocate and transform text; byte-preserving uses must avoid unwanted normalization, and Swift ownership still needs a separate design. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/B/C30.json.

sources.title: RapidJSON counted strings and explicit copying versus borrowing
sources.sections_read: Pointer-plus-length constructor, constant complexity, NUL support, lifetime contract
sources.confirmed: A counted string reference stores a pointer and length without copying; it supports interior NUL characters and requires source storage to outlive use.
sources.limits: Borrowed storage must outlive its users; string-reference construction alone does not establish Unicode validity. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/B/C30.json.
